value.rationale: The paper distinguishes quasi-norm differentiability and metric-Lipschitz rigidity for ℓ_p. This canonical analytic-coordinate sequence supplies the precise critical near-Lipschitz logarithmic loss and, more significantly, a positive finite exact Hausdorff gauge and matching sharp entropy constant for a natural nonrectifiable embedded circle of metric dimension 1/p. These invariants are not arbitrary truncation parameters and identify a sharp geometric boundary, beyond a basic negative differentiability example.
